mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the past month indicates a tightening labor market, which typically precedes wage inflation and tighter monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases over two months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past two months signals weakening supply-side fundamentals, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative, it signals a liquidity trap and potential deflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and GDPC1 growth < 0%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 over the past month, combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3%, signals strong labor market conditions and potential wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by > 300,000 and UNRATE decreases by > 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real final sales of domestic product (RSAFS) over the past two months signals strengthening consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of broader economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS increases over two months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 0.25% in a single month, it signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25%.
